name: Shinonome Miu
source:
A girl who lives in the area where the extracurricular activities camp is being held. She is fascinated with the world of the occult, and is the one who tells the company about the forbidden shrine. She is a mysterious girl who throws others off track with her eccentric behavior. Lost in another world, she is excited to be freed from her overprotective older brother, but...

Her digimon partner is Syakomon.

[Edited from [url=https://www.gematsu.com/2020/04/digimon-survive-details-miu-shinonome-syakomon]Gematsu's translation[/url]]
